description: Hamming(7,4) encoder: three parity bits and four data bits in the standard bit order
notes: Real-world error-correcting code; function written by us from the definition (bit order p1 p2 d1 p3 d2 d3 d4 from bit 0). clang trunk -O3 -march=skylake extracts every bit and combines them with xors, shifts and disjoint ors: 25 IR instructions. Whether a shorter form exists is unknown.
